verdict: F5 closed its fiscal year with revenue up 13% to $917 million on a 23% jump in product sales, though GAAP net income slipped slightly to $186 million as operating costs rose faster than sales.

segments.name: Systems
segments.note: Hardware appliances that deliver and secure applications — revenue grew 29% as customers refreshed data-center gear.

segments.name: Software
segments.note: Software versions of the same delivery and security tools, sold by subscription and license — up 19%.

segments.name: Services
segments.note: Maintenance, support and consulting attached to the products — the steady base, up 3%. (Reported as $408M in the release's rounded summary.)

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: The sales force and marketing that sell F5's products and services.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Engineers building and improving the application delivery and security platform.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Finance, legal, HR and the rest of the back office.

opex.name: Restructuring
opex.note: One-off restructuring charges, mainly workforce and facility-exit costs.

otherDetail: Other income, net was $17.8M as reported — mostly interest earned on F5's cash and investments (shown rounded here).

takeaways.title: Products drove the quarter
takeaways.text: Product revenue rose 23% to $510M — systems up 29% and software up 19% — the ninth straight quarter of double-digit product growth.

takeaways.title: GAAP margin narrowed
takeaways.text: GAAP operating margin was 23.1%, down from 25.4% a year ago, as sales & marketing and other costs grew faster than revenue. Non-GAAP operating margin was 33.7%.

takeaways.title: More buybacks authorized
takeaways.text: The board added $1.5B to the share repurchase program, on top of $322M still remaining — while fiscal 2027 guidance calls for slower revenue growth of 8% to 9%.

oneTimers: GAAP results include $7.4M of restructuring charges and stock-based compensation of $67.5M; excluding these and other items, non-GAAP net income was $255M, or $4.42 per share.

sources.label: Official earnings release (F5, as furnished to the SEC on Form 8-K Ex. 99.1)

footerNote: Figures are rounded to the nearest $1M from the release's thousands; segment and flow lines use the exact statement amounts, so totals match the reported $917M revenue, $754M gross profit, $212M operating income and $186M net income.
